id./param/scenario/cs/b_030_cs_140.pack|cs_: "Oh, {var:1}. You're late.
"What? Why are you staring at me?
"He's startled that you look your old self. For a while you were skin and bones.
"Ho ho ho! That's nothing compared to the Grand Master's training. A good meal and I'm back to normal.
"{var:1}, Lord Robert told me you met the Grand Master in the netherworld and trained.
"And you learned Erdwin's move and even the temple's final secret. I am truly delighted.
"Ah, Hendrik. I hear you looked after {var:1} while I was away. My thanks.
"Think nothing of it. After my past rudeness, it was the least I could do. I should be the one apologizing...
"It's fine, Hendrik. Lift your head. You were also a poor man tossed by fate. I don't blame you.
"...But Lord Robert, what do we do now? I thought coming to Angri-La would show us something.
"I have an idea. According to the Grand Master, Erdwin flew the skies in a divine vessel to fight the Dark One.
"A divine vessel...?
"I don't know the details, but if we get that vessel, we may find a way to defeat Mordegon in the sky.
"And our scattered friends. They never give up, so they must be alive somewhere.
"{var:1}, search for your friends and follow Erdwin's trail. Visit the sacred land of Arboria again.
"No time to lose. We must crush Mordegon's ambition. Everyone, let's go.

Rab rejoined the party!
Rab's Character Builder panels were newly unlocked!
Rab can now use Pearly Gates, and {var:1} and Rab can use the pep power Solar Flair!
"The people of Angri-La will help {var:1} fight the mighty Mordegon.
"We have prepared special training for the Luminary. If you wish to build your power, visit our Field of Discipline."
